sources.launcher:
import ctypes, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
file = os.fsencode(sys.argv[1])
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
execve = libc.execve
execve.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p)]
execve.restype = ctypes.c_int
argv = [file, b'-rR', b'--no-print-directory']
entries = [k + b'=' + v for k, v in os.environb.items()]
entries.extend(bytes.fromhex(line) for line in Path('extra-entries').read_text().splitlines())
execve(file, (ctypes.c_char_p * (len(argv) + 1))(*argv, None),
       (ctypes.c_char_p * (len(entries) + 1))(*entries, None))
raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), os.strerror(ctypes.get_errno()))
